name: arbor
description: Context Arbor in Claude Code: memory and code tools, a guard on whole reads of large files, compaction between turns at your window, a lean start context, Jev and exact per-turn accounting.

readGuardKb.title: Read guard, KB
readGuardKb.description: A whole Read of an indexed file larger than this answers with its outline first; 0 turns the guard off.

compactAt.title: Compact at
compactAt.description: Compact between turns once the context reaches this size; auto takes the window your own sessions replay cheapest (session compaction --json).

slimInstructions.title: Lean CLAUDE.md block
slimInstructions.description: Replace the Context Arbor block of CLAUDE.md with a short one that points at the arbor tools, and attach the active task from memory/NOW.md.

jevProvider.title: Jev
jevProvider.description: Who picks the notes for each prompt: arbor (OpenRouter, as `arbor.py jev on` set it), claude (a model of your Claude plan, daily cap from .arbor/config.json) or off.

jevModel.title: Jev model (claude)
jevModel.description: Model alias or id for jevProvider=claude.

recordTurns.title: Record turns
recordTurns.description: Append each turn's exact tokens and the session cost to .arbor/turns.jsonl (numbers only) for arbor stats and arbor ui.
